name: Lookup Search
tagline: A lookup column as a type-ahead search over the target table.

limitations: The demo’s Dataverse is a fixture held in your browser: twelve contacts across three accounts, and the two lookups from contact to account a real environment often has (Company Name and a Managing Partner column). Search, Browse and the parent filter go through the same Web API calls and relationship metadata a form sends, answered from that fixture. Nothing is saved, and Reset or a reload puts it back.
Browse opens the demo’s own lookup dialog, a searchable list of the contact table. The platform’s dialog also offers views and columns, which the demo’s does not.

The parent is set by the preset, not by another field. On a form, Filter by follows a lookup the user changes; here, switching between the Filtered and Two linking columns presets is the way to change it, and On parent change: Clear it acts on that switch.
The Linking column warning for a form that sets Linking column without mapping Filter by cannot be shown. The demo builds every lookup property as mapped, so the control never sees an unmapped one.
A refused request, such as a user without read access to contacts, cannot be shown: the demo’s Dataverse grants everything. Opening the selected record reports the call and navigates nowhere.

presets.name: Search
presets.description: An empty lookup. Type "an" to search contacts by name or email address, each with the address on a second line; Browse opens the lookup dialog.

presets.name: A record selected
presets.description: The state a form is usually in: a lookup that already points somewhere. Clear it to search again.

presets.name: Filtered by account
presets.description: Filter by is mapped to the account on the form, which holds Acme Corporation. Type "an": only Acme’s contacts come back, the field says so, and Browse is hidden because the platform dialog cannot be filtered.

presets.name: Two linking columns
presets.description: The same parent with Linking column left empty. Two columns on contact point at account, so the control names both and waits for the maker to choose rather than guessing.

presets.name: Search only
presets.description: Allow browse switched off, for forms that want one way in rather than two. Contains matching, from three characters.
